title: GitHub PR Buttons config
description: Buttons in the pull request sidebar, from .github/pr-buttons.yml. Each one dispatches a workflow on the PR's head branch. See https://github.com/frolic/github-pr-buttons

workflow.description: The workflow file name in .github/workflows, without a directory. The workflow must have a workflow_dispatch trigger.

paths.description: When the PR changes no matching file, the button moves into the collapsed "Other workflows" section. Same rules as a workflow's on.pull_request.paths: * does not match /, ** does, a pattern that starts with ! excludes, and the last pattern that matches a file decides.
